explication: whatsapp-web.js is a Node.js client library that automates WhatsApp Web through Puppeteer. The principal workflow is: an application configures Client, authentication prepares session state, the client launches a managed browser, WhatsApp Web receives actions and emits events, and Client converts results into typed chat, contact, message, media, group, channel, and poll structures. The graph reflects sampled runtime code and README capabilities; many individual Client methods were not sampled, so their internal action wiring is intentionally condensed.
